datasets.name: ds_activity
queryLines:
SELECT
  province_psgc,
  province_name                         AS reporting_unit,
  unit_type,
  region_name,
  year,
  latitude,                             -- map point (Gold dim_province, COD-AB)
  longitude,
  total_travelers,                      -- NULL when DOT did not report; never shown as 0
  population_total,
  tourism_intensity_per_1000,
  tourism_rank,
  intensity_rank,
  tourism_share_pct,
  CASE traveler_value_status
    WHEN 'reported'         THEN 'Reported'
    WHEN 'dash_as_zero'     THEN 'Reported (blank categories counted as 0)'
    WHEN 'reported_partial' THEN 'Partly reported'
    WHEN 'not_reported'     THEN 'Not reported by DOT'
  END                                   AS data_status,
  comparable_to_2019,
  comparability_note,
  activity_eligible,
  activity_exclusion_reason,
  intensity_eligible,
  intensity_exclusion_reason
FROM tuklas_dev.`05_analytics`.tourism_activity

datasets.name: ds_recovery
queryLines:
SELECT
  province_psgc,
  province_name                         AS reporting_unit,
  unit_type,
  region_name,
  comparison_year,
  travelers_2019,
  travelers_comparison_year,
  traveler_change_absolute,
  recovery_index,
  CASE recovery_class
    WHEN 'above_2019' THEN 'Above 2019'
    WHEN 'unchanged'  THEN 'Same as 2019'
    WHEN 'below_2019' THEN 'Below 2019'
    ELSE 'Not assessed'
  END                                   AS recovery_status,
  recovery_eligible,
  usual_strong_destination_2019,        -- 2019 top 10 (DL-026)
  CASE WHEN usual_strong_destination_2019 THEN 'Usual leaders (2019 top 10)' ELSE 'Other places' END AS destination_group,
  CASE destination_label
    WHEN 'possible_emerging' THEN 'Possible emerging destination'
    WHEN 'under_review'      THEN 'Under review'
  END                                   AS destination_label,
  destination_label_reason,
  baseline_under_review_2019,
  small_base_2019,
  recovery_exclusion_reason,
  comp_comparison                       AS comparable_to_2019,   -- comparison year comparable to 2019
  comparability_note
FROM tuklas_dev.`05_analytics`.tourism_recovery

datasets.name: ds_recovery_compare
queryLines:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
  province_psgc,
  province_name                         AS reporting_unit,
  unit_type,
  region_name,
  MAX(CASE WHEN comparison_year = 2022 THEN recovery_index END) AS recovery_index_2022,
  MAX(CASE WHEN comparison_year = 2023 THEN recovery_index END) AS recovery_index_2023,
  MAX(CASE WHEN comparison_year = 2023 THEN recovery_class END) AS recovery_class_2023
FROM tuklas_dev.`05_analytics`.tourism_recovery
GROUP BY province_psgc, province_name, unit_type, region_name
) WHERE recovery_index_2022 IS NOT NULL AND recovery_index_2023 IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: ds_segments
queryLines:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT * FROM tuklas_dev.`05_analytics`.traveler_segment_recovery
)
SELECT province_psgc, province_name AS reporting_unit, unit_type, region_name, comparison_year,
       'Domestic' AS segment, 1 AS segment_order,
       domestic_travelers_2019 AS travelers_2019, domestic_travelers_2023 AS travelers_comparison,
       domestic_recovery_index AS recovery_index, domestic_recovery_class AS recovery_class,
       domestic_eligible AS eligible, domestic_exclusion_reason AS exclusion_reason,
       CASE WHEN domestic_eligible THEN 'Assessed' ELSE 'Not assessed' END AS coverage_status,
       overall_recovery_index, foreign_includes_overseas_filipinos, comparability_note
FROM s
UNION ALL
SELECT province_psgc, province_name, unit_type, region_name, comparison_year,
       'Foreign', 2,
       foreign_travelers_2019, foreign_travelers_2023,
       foreign_recovery_index, foreign_recovery_class,
       foreign_eligible, foreign_exclusion_reason,
       CASE WHEN foreign_eligible THEN 'Assessed' ELSE 'Not assessed' END,
       overall_recovery_index, foreign_includes_overseas_filipinos, comparability_note
FROM s
UNION ALL
SELECT province_psgc, province_name, unit_type, region_name, comparison_year,
       'Overseas Filipinos', 3,
       overseas_filipino_travelers_2019, overseas_filipino_travelers_2023,
       overseas_filipino_recovery_index, overseas_filipino_recovery_class,
       overseas_filipino_eligible, overseas_filipino_exclusion_reason,
       CASE WHEN overseas_filipino_eligible THEN 'Assessed' ELSE 'Not assessed' END,
       overall_recovery_index, foreign_includes_overseas_filipinos, comparability_note
FROM s

datasets.name: ds_economy
queryLines:
SELECT
  province_psgc,
  province_name                         AS reporting_unit,
  unit_type,
  region_name,
  latitude,                             -- map point (Gold dim_province, COD-AB)
  longitude,
  travelers_2019,
  travelers_2023,
  recovery_index_2023,
  CASE recovery_class_2023
    WHEN 'above_2019' THEN 'Above 2019'
    WHEN 'unchanged'  THEN 'Same as 2019'
    WHEN 'below_2019' THEN 'Below 2019'
    ELSE 'Not assessed'
  END                                   AS recovery_status_2023,
  usual_strong_destination_2019,
  CASE destination_label
    WHEN 'possible_emerging' THEN 'Possible emerging destination'
    WHEN 'under_review'      THEN 'Under review'
    ELSE 'No label'
  END                                   AS destination_label,
  tourism_change_pct,
  CASE WHEN tourism_change_pct > 300 THEN 300 ELSE tourism_change_pct END AS tourism_change_pct_chart,
  CASE WHEN recovery_index_2023 > 400 THEN 400 ELSE recovery_index_2023 END AS recovery_index_2023_chart,
  coalesce(tourism_change_pct > 300, false) AS shown_at_chart_cap,
  afs_gva_growth_pct,
  afs_share_of_gdp_pct,
  gdp_per_capita_current_2019,
  gdp_per_capita_current_2023,
  tourism_intensity_per_1000_2023,
  coalesce(tourism_economy_pattern_label, 'Not assessed') AS pattern,   -- approved wording from Analytics (#65)
  CASE tourism_economy_pattern
    WHEN 'tourism_up_economy_up'     THEN 1
    WHEN 'tourism_up_economy_down'   THEN 2
    WHEN 'tourism_down_economy_up'   THEN 3
    WHEN 'tourism_down_economy_down' THEN 4
    ELSE 9
  END                                   AS pattern_order,
  CASE WHEN tourism_economy_pattern IN ('tourism_up_economy_up', 'tourism_down_economy_down')
       THEN 'Same direction'
       WHEN tourism_economy_pattern IN ('tourism_up_economy_down', 'tourism_down_economy_up')
       THEN 'Opposite directions'
       WHEN tourism_economy_pattern LIKE '%unchanged%' THEN 'No change'
       ELSE 'Not assessed'
  END                                   AS alignment,
  alignment_eligible,
  alignment_exclusion_reason,
  afs_share_eligible,
  tourism_intensity_eligible,
  comp_2023                             AS comparable_to_2019,
  population_source_2023
FROM tuklas_dev.`05_analytics`.tourism_economy

  afs_gva_growth_pct,
  afs_share_of_gdp_pct,
  gdp_per_capita_current_2019,
  gdp_per_capita_current_2023,
  tourism_intensity_per_1000_2023,
  coalesce(tourism_economy_pattern_label, 'Not assessed') AS pattern,   -- approved wording from Analytics (#65)
  CASE tourism_economy_pattern
    WHEN 'tourism_up_economy_up'     THEN 1
    WHEN 'tourism_up_economy_down'   THEN 2
    WHEN 'tourism_down_economy_up'   THEN 3
    WHEN 'tourism_down_economy_down' THEN 4
    ELSE 9
  END                                   AS pattern_order,
  CASE WHEN tourism_economy_pattern IN ('tourism_up_economy_up', 'tourism_down_economy_down')
       THEN 'Same direction'
       WHEN tourism_economy_pattern IN ('tourism_up_economy_down', 'tourism_down_economy_up')
       THEN 'Opposite directions'
       WHEN tourism_economy_pattern LIKE '%unchanged%' THEN 'No change'
       ELSE 'Not assessed'
  END                                   AS alignment,
  alignment_eligible,
  alignment_exclusion_reason,
  afs_share_eligible,
  tourism_intensity_eligible,
  comp_2023                             AS comparable_to_2019,
  population_source_2023
FROM tuklas_dev.`05_analytics`.tourism_economy
) WHERE shown_at_chart_cap

datasets.name: ds_caveats
queryLines:
SELECT
  province_name                         AS reporting_unit,
  unit_type,
  region_name,
  year,
  CASE
    WHEN traveler_value_status = 'not_reported' THEN 'DOT did not report travelers for this unit and year; shown as blank, not 0.'
    WHEN comparable_to_2019 IS NOT TRUE        THEN 'DOT changed how this unit is counted after 2019, so it is not compared with 2019.'
    WHEN traveler_value_status = 'reported_partial' THEN 'Only part of the unit was reported.'
  END                                   AS caveat,
  comparability_note                    -- source wording, for reviewers
FROM tuklas_dev.`05_analytics`.tourism_activity
WHERE traveler_value_status IN ('not_reported', 'reported_partial') OR comparable_to_2019 IS NOT TRUE

datasets.name: ds_p_pareto
queryLines:
SELECT *,
  lpad(cast(tourism_rank AS STRING), 2, '0') || ' ' || reporting_unit AS ranked_unit,
  CASE WHEN tourism_rank <= 10 THEN 'Top 10' ELSE 'Ranks 11-30' END AS rank_group,
  SUM(tourism_share_pct) OVER (ORDER BY tourism_rank) AS cumulative_share_pct
FROM (
SELECT
  province_psgc,
  province_name                         AS reporting_unit,
  unit_type,
  region_name,
  year,
  latitude,                             -- map point (Gold dim_province, COD-AB)
  longitude,
  total_travelers,                      -- NULL when DOT did not report; never shown as 0
  population_total,
  tourism_intensity_per_1000,
  tourism_rank,
  intensity_rank,
  tourism_share_pct,
  CASE traveler_value_status
    WHEN 'reported'         THEN 'Reported'
    WHEN 'dash_as_zero'     THEN 'Reported (blank categories counted as 0)'
    WHEN 'reported_partial' THEN 'Partly reported'
    WHEN 'not_reported'     THEN 'Not reported by DOT'
  END                                   AS data_status,
  comparable_to_2019,
  comparability_note,
  activity_eligible,
  activity_exclusion_reason,
  intensity_eligible,
  intensity_exclusion_reason
FROM tuklas_dev.`05_analytics`.tourism_activity
) WHERE year = 2023 AND activity_eligible AND tourism_rank <= 30

datasets.name: ds_p_segments
queryLines:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH s AS (
  SELECT * FROM tuklas_dev.`05_analytics`.traveler_segment_recovery
)
SELECT province_psgc, province_name AS reporting_unit, unit_type, region_name, comparison_year,
       'Domestic' AS segment, 1 AS segment_order,
       domestic_travelers_2019 AS travelers_2019, domestic_travelers_2023 AS travelers_comparison,
       domestic_recovery_index AS recovery_index, domestic_recovery_class AS recovery_class,
       domestic_eligible AS eligible, domestic_exclusion_reason AS exclusion_reason,
       CASE WHEN domestic_eligible THEN 'Assessed' ELSE 'Not assessed' END AS coverage_status,
       overall_recovery_index, foreign_includes_overseas_filipinos, comparability_note
FROM s
UNION ALL
SELECT province_psgc, province_name, unit_type, region_name, comparison_year,
       'Foreign', 2,
       foreign_travelers_2019, foreign_travelers_2023,
       foreign_recovery_index, foreign_recovery_class,
       foreign_eligible, foreign_exclusion_reason,
       CASE WHEN foreign_eligible THEN 'Assessed' ELSE 'Not assessed' END,
       overall_recovery_index, foreign_includes_overseas_filipinos, comparability_note
FROM s
UNION ALL
SELECT province_psgc, province_name, unit_type, region_name, comparison_year,
       'Overseas Filipinos', 3,
       overseas_filipino_travelers_2019, overseas_filipino_travelers_2023,
       overseas_filipino_recovery_index, overseas_filipino_recovery_class,
       overseas_filipino_eligible, overseas_filipino_exclusion_reason,
       CASE WHEN overseas_filipino_eligible THEN 'Assessed' ELSE 'Not assessed' END,
       overall_recovery_index, foreign_includes_overseas_filipinos, comparability_note
FROM s
) WHERE eligible AND segment IN ('Domestic', 'Foreign')

lines:
**NCR note:** NCR is shown as one unit, and some NCR cities printed "-" for all traveler counts: 8 cities in 2019, 4 in 2023. Part of NCR's rise therefore reflects more cities reporting, not only recovery. Its status is "Partly reported" (`reported_partial`); how to treat it is still to be decided (DL-019).

**Read with caution (OI-5):** DOT printed some towns as "-" in 2019 that report in 2023, so part of the change reflects wider reporting: Camarines Sur (Naga City), Romblon, Surigao del Norte (Siargao Islands), Ilocos Norte (Batac, Pasuquin), Misamis Oriental (Gingoog City), Leyte (Matalom) and Sorsogon.

**Data notes:** Blank means DOT did not report the unit that year; it is never shown as 0. Where DOT printed "-" for a traveler category it is counted as 0. Aklan is not compared with 2019 because DOT changed how it counts Aklan from 2021. Totals cover included reporting units only, not the whole country. Patterns show association, not cause.

The 52 units still **below 2019 in 2023**, by traveler group (2023 vs 2019). Read each group with its coverage: a group is not assessed where its 2019 count is 0 or "-", or where DOT counts foreign travelers and overseas Filipinos together.
